title: MASTERING DISCORD: HIDDEN FEATURES TO UPGRADE YOUR STUDY SESSIONS
excerpt: Think you know everything about how Discord works? Beyond basic chatting and voice calls, the platform offers powerful built-in tools to help you organize your study notes and collaborate better. From mastering text formatting to keeping complex discussions tidy with threads, discover how to use Discord like a pro at BrainlyHQ. Taking a few minutes to learn these native tricks will save you hours of scrolling and make your daily learning routine much more efficient.
body:
## Unlock Discord's Full Potential

Many members use BrainlyHQ just to send a quick text message or hop into a voice channel. But Discord is packed with native features that can transform a chaotic chat into a highly organized study workspace.

Whether you are coordinating a massive group project or just trying to explain a difficult concept, knowing how the platform works under the hood can make a huge difference.

## Level Up Your Text with Markdown

Did you know you can format your messages to make them much easier to read? Discord uses a lightweight formatting system called Markdown. This is especially useful when you are sharing formulas, long historical explanations, or coding snippets.

Here are a few quick formatting tricks you can type directly into the chat box:

- **Bold Text:** Wrap your text in double asterisks to highlight key terms (\*\*important term\*\*)..
- **Italics:** Use single asterisks for emphasis (\*note\*)..
- **Underline:** Use two underscores (__pay attention to this__)..
- **Code Blocks:** If you are sharing a lot of text or a programming assignment, wrap your message in three backticks (\`\`\`). This creates a neat, readable box that stands out from regular chat..

> Good to see: [https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/210298617-Markdown-Text-101-Chat-Formatting-Bold-Italic-Underline](https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/210298617-Markdown-Text-101-Chat-Formatting-Bold-Italic-Underline)

## Keep It Organized with Threads

Have you ever tried to ask a follow-up question, but the main chat was moving too fast? That is exactly what Threads are for.

Instead of interrupting an ongoing conversation or losing your train of thought, you can hover over any message and click the Create Thread icon (it looks like a speech bubble with a hashtag). This opens a separate, focused side-chat dedicated entirely to that specific topic. Once the problem is solved, the thread automatically archives itself, keeping the main channels perfectly clean!

## Never Miss an Update with the Inbox

With so many regional communities and subject channels on BrainlyHQ, it is easy to lose track of replies.

Instead of scrolling through every channel to see if someone answered your question, click the Inbox icon (the tray symbol in the top right corner of your Discord app). The Mentions tab will show you exactly where someone replied to you, and the Unreads tab will help you catch up on important server announcements without feeling overwhelmed.

Start using these native Discord tools today and make your study sessions smoother and more efficient!
